sql.ahj.list: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, st.id AS "state_id", st.state, ahj.metro_area_id, ma.metro_area FROM brs.ahj ahj INNER JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = ahj.metro_area_id INNER JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON ma.sales_area_id = sa.id INNER JOIN flow.state st ON sa.state_id = st.id WHERE ahj.archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY st.state, ma.metro_area, ahj.name
sql.ahj.findById: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, st.id AS "state_id", st.state, ahj.metro_area_id, ma.metro_area FROM brs.ahj ahj INNER JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = ahj.metro_area_id INNER JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON ma.sales_area_id = sa.id INNER JOIN flow.state st ON sa.state_id = st.id WHERE ahj.id = :id
sql.ahj.checkForDuplicate: SELECT ahj.id, ahj.name, st.id AS "state_id", st.state, ahj.metro_area_id, ma.metro_area FROM brs.ahj ahj INNER JOIN brs.metro_area ma ON ma.id = ahj.metro_area_id INNER JOIN brs.sales_area sa ON ma.sales_area_id = sa.id INNER JOIN flow.state st ON sa.state_id = st.id WHERE ahj.name = :name AND ahj.metro_area_id = :metroAreaId AND ahj.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.ahj.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj (name, metro_area_id, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id) VALUES (:name, :metroAreaId, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser)
sql.ahj.update: UPDATE brs.ahj SET name = :name, metro_area_id = :metroAreaId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj SET archived = TRUE WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.checklist.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_checklist (description, display_order, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, checklist_type_id, failed_inspection_resource_id, failed_inspection_date, failed_inspection_project) VALUES (:description, :displayOrder, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser, :checklistTypeId, :failedInspectionResourceId, :failedInspectionDate, :failedInspectionProject)
sql.ahj.checklist.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_checklist SET description = :description, display_order = :displayOrder, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser, checklist_type_id = :checklistTypeId, failed_inspection_resource_id = :failedInspectionResourceId, failed_inspection_date = :failedInspectionDate, failed_inspection_project = :failedInspectionProject WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.checklist.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_checklist SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.contact.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_contact (name, title, email, phone_number, address, notes, hours, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, contact_type_id) VALUES (:name, :title, :email, :phoneNumber, :address, :notes, :hours, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser, :contactTypeId)
sql.ahj.contact.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_contact SET name = :name, title = :title, email = :email, phone_number = :phoneNumber, address = :address, notes = :notes, hours = :hours, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :contactId
sql.ahj.contact.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_contact SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :contactId
